Website information

Cookie Policy

Effective and last updated September 23, 2026

About this policy

This policy explains how the Integrative Pain Clinic website uses cookies and similar browser technology. A cookie is a small text file a site or service can place in a browser. Local storage is a related browser feature that can remember a setting on a device.

Essential technology

The website host and access providers may use cookies or similar technology needed to deliver the site, maintain secure access, prevent abuse, balance traffic, and remember a signed-in session. These functions may be required for the site to work and are not controlled by the optional-media setting.

Your saved selection

This site stores a value named ipc_cookie_preference in your browser’s local storage. It records either “essential” or “media” so the site can remember your selection. The value remains until you change it, clear the site’s browser data, use a private browsing session that ends, or the browser removes it.

Optional YouTube media

Embedded YouTube videos on the patient resources page remain off unless you select “Allow optional media.” If allowed, the site loads YouTube’s privacy-enhanced player from youtube-nocookie.com. YouTube may still receive technical information, such as an IP address and browser details, and may set or read information according to its own policies when you interact with the player.

Selecting “Essential only” prevents those embedded players from loading. Direct “Open on YouTube” links remain available; opening one takes you to YouTube and is governed by YouTube’s practices.

Analytics and advertising

The clinic does not currently place custom analytics or advertising cookies through this website. The clinic will update this policy and the site’s controls if that changes.

External services

Links to Google Forms, Google Meet, Google Maps, Helcim, YouTube, and other external sites lead to services with their own cookies, local storage, and privacy practices. The clinic’s cookie setting does not control technology used after you open an external site.

Change your selection

Use the “Cookie choices” button in any page footer to select “Essential only” or “Allow optional media.” You may also clear cookies and site data in your browser settings. Blocking essential technology at the browser level may affect access to the site.

Contact

Questions about this policy may be directed to Integrative Pain Clinic at (610) 732-4251 or 1572 McDaniel Drive, West Chester, PA 19380.
